# Standard Deviation

**Authors:** Samy El Omda, Shane R. Sergent

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

The standard deviation (SD) measures the extent of scattering in a set of values, typically compared to the mean value of the set. The calculation of the SD depends on whether the dataset includes the entire target population or merely samples it. Ideally, studies obtain data from an entire population, which defines the population parameter. However, this is rarely possible in medical research, so a population sample is often used.
